meta.note: Price and dosing facts. Dosing quotes come from FDA labels (DailyMed); prices are the manufacturer's self-pay price at the maintenance dose used for the evidence, checked on the date in as_of. `concordance_pipeline.build_matrix verify` re-checks every quote. Only approved facts replace the sample placeholders.
meta.convenience_rule: Once weekly = 100, once daily = 60; minus 20 for a daily injection; minus 20 for a fasting or timing rule. Injection vs pill otherwise doesn't change the score, because the limits step already lets people rule out injections.
